The introduced Calvin carbon-accounting lesson retains three five-carbon RuBP packets plus three one-carbon CO2 inputs, six three-carbon fixation products, five retained G3P packets and one net exported G3P packet. Pentagon/triangle/circle glyphs are nonchemical accounting tokens. The two squares represent whole ATP reservoirs (6 for reduction and 3 for regeneration); the capsule represents the whole 6-NADPH reservoir, quantities explained externally. All source flow directions and the regeneration loop remain. Shapes and stations are independently spaced without changing counts, carbon accounting or connections; fixed 1.4 mm lines and regenerated Index dots are used.
